goal: Read the user-specified local recording and return compact evidence for a later DN-Splatter input decision.

user_reported_source.wsl_path_use_condition: Use only after verifying this path exists and refers to the intended Windows file; do not assume the H drive is mounted.

execution_scope.host: user local Windows computer or its already available WSL environment
execution_scope.if_source_is_unavailable: Report the exact checked path and execution host, retain completed preparation, and request execution on the local host that can read H:\capture.bag. Do not invent a server path or upload requirement.

environment.optional_python_reader: rosbags, in an isolated project environment if needed and compatible with the detected recording format
environment.vendor_recording_policy: Identify magic/header, connection information and embedded types first. A vendor SDK recording or unsupported message is not automatically corrupt; use an already available suitable SDK or document the specific missing decoder.
environment.memory_policy: Stream messages and statistics; do not load the entire bag or retain all decoded images in RAM.
environment.cpu_policy: Measure the local host separately and use bounded parallel image analysis. The AutoDL 25-CPU allocation is not the local computer's measured allocation.
environment.github_policy: Use the local host's existing GitHub connection and credentials. AutoDL official academic acceleration remains preferred for operations actually run on AutoDL; do not copy its proxy settings to Windows or global configuration.

source_integrity.sha256_method: One streaming SHA-256 pass over the original file, without a duplicate source copy. Message scanning may be a separate pass.
source_integrity.if_source_changes_during_analysis: Mark the report incomplete and identify the change; do not claim one stable recording was fully verified or stop unrelated processes.

topic_inventory.coverage: All available connections and topics from the recording metadata, with observed counts checked during applicable scans.

timing.scan_scope: Full message/header timestamp stream for selected RGB, depth, CameraInfo, TF, pose/odometry and relevant IMU topics; do not decode every image merely to measure timestamps.
timing.json_absolute_nanosecond_representation: decimal strings to avoid loss of precision in JavaScript readers
timing.zero_stamp_policy: Interpret by message semantics. Zero CameraInfo or static TF stamps can be valid; do not count them as dynamic-stream timing failure by default.
timing.full_per_message_timestamp_tables: Keep locally; publish bounded summaries, plots and a small set of largest-gap examples.
timing.reader_iteration_order_caveat: If the reader sorts records by recorded timestamps, sorted iteration does not establish original physical write order. Report which ordering is actually observable and audit header-time regressions in the stated iteration order.
timing.reader_concurrency: Do not concurrently or interleavingly iterate the same AnyReader. Parallelize independent image analysis only after copying the bounded selected payloads.

synchronization.candidate_pairs: Each plausible RGB/depth pair and its applicable calibration/pose streams; do not silently choose the first topic.
synchronization.matching: Report signed nearest-neighbor time differences and a one-to-one, non-reused association for candidate usable RGB-D pairs.
synchronization.if_clock_relationship_is_unknown: Report record-time and header-time evidence separately; do not present an unverified alignment as synchronized input.

frame_graph_and_poses.inputs: Relevant TF, TF-static, odometry and pose messages, including each transform's own header when the outer message has no header.
frame_graph_and_poses.public_trajectory: Publish a time-relative, origin-centered trajectory and motion summaries. Retain transform definitions, relative reference frames, axis conventions and units. Keep raw geodetic coordinates, the absolute origin and any transform that could recover the original absolute location local.

image_quality.sampling: Uniform sampling across the full usable time span plus bounded additional samples around gaps, calibration changes or conspicuous image problems.
image_quality.quality_thresholds: Report measured distributions and interpretation; do not invent universal pass/fail blur or exposure thresholds.

depth_quality.sample_policy: Use the associated representative samples; label all statistics as sampled rather than full-recording pixel statistics.
depth_quality.compressed_depth_policy: Identify compressedDepth transport and reconstruct its original values with a compatible decoder; do not treat every compressed image payload as an ordinary JPEG/PNG or strip an assumed fixed header without evidence.
depth_quality.if_scale_or_registration_is_unknown: Keep raw-value diagnostics and mark the unresolved condition. Do not label an assumed scale as measured metres.

optional_geometric_checks.condition: Run only when camera intrinsics, depth interpretation, camera poses and coordinate/unit relationships are supported by evidence.
optional_geometric_checks.scope: Sparse backprojection and a few relative-view overlays to assess scale, axis convention and overlap; no full reconstruction or training.
optional_geometric_checks.outputs: Small previews and residual summaries with occlusion/mask definitions; any full point clouds remain local.
optional_geometric_checks.when_prerequisites_are_missing: Mark not performed and list the exact missing prerequisites.

return_package.run_id_rule: Generate from actual audit start time and the first eight characters of the measured source SHA-256. If source access prevents hashing, use an explicit source-unavailable suffix and explain it; do not fabricate a hash or an observed run id in this plan.

required_files.overview.md: Human-readable findings, exact inspected source, actual coverage, candidate RGB-D/pose path, missing prerequisites and the recommended next action.
required_files.summary.json: Machine-readable source identity, audit status, report versions, selected topics, evidence-based readiness items, unresolved questions and links to detailed report files.
required_files.topic_inventory.json: All observed topics/connections, types, counts, role evidence and decoder support.
required_files.timing.json: Full-scan timestamp summaries and bounded gap/reset examples for selected streams.
required_files.sync.json: Candidate and selected RGB-D/calibration/pose associations, clock basis, unique-match coverage and offset distributions.
required_files.calibration.json: Necessary camera models, intrinsics and relevant relative extrinsics with sources and change segments; absent items explicitly missing.
required_files.frame_graph.json: Relevant frame relationships, static/dynamic status and evidence for a usable camera-pose chain.
required_files.trajectory.json: Relative/origin-centered pose summaries, validity/coverage and tracking limits, or an explicit no-usable-poses result.
required_files.image_quality.json: Sample-defined RGB/IR/image quality and viewpoint/static-scene observations.
required_files.depth_quality.json: Sample-defined original-value depth diagnostics, units evidence and registration assessment, or depth-unavailable status.
required_files.samples_metadata.json: Per returned sample: original topic, message identity, record/header timestamp, encoding, shape, calibration/pose linkage, synchronization offset and every preview/crop/resize transform.
required_files.artifact_manifest.json: Returned data/report files' relative paths, sizes and SHA-256; total package size; original bag explicitly excluded. Exclude this manifest itself from its recursive hash list, or use a separate checksum sidecar with an explicit scope.

required_small_numeric_samples.rgb: Original compressed color payload when directly usable, or lossless decoded RGB with its original encoding and conversion recorded.
required_small_numeric_samples.depth: Lossless NPZ/NPY or compatible lossless integer PNG preserving original decoded numeric values, dtype, units-known-or-unknown and invalid-value representation; colorized depth is only an additional preview.
required_small_numeric_samples.selection: Representative early/middle/late usable portions, including a problematic sample when present; use the exact timestamps and associations in samples_metadata.json.
required_small_numeric_samples.budget_policy: Prefer lossless compression and three pairs. If complete frames alone exceed the publication budget, retain documented original-value ROIs plus full-view previews and exact crop/intrinsic mapping; explicitly report this limitation rather than quantizing depth.

contents: relative trajectory or coverage plot when meaningful
bounded registration or geometry check views
previews.depth_colorbar_units: Use metres only with verified scale; otherwise label raw units.

keep_local_only: full-resolution exports beyond the representative subset
unnecessary device serial numbers or private paths

publication.if_over_budget: Reduce or compress nonessential previews and excess examples while retaining numeric diagnostics, representative lossless samples and all missing-data disclosures. Keep full details local.
publication.if_github_is_unavailable: Retain the local compact report and provide its directory and precise push error; do not switch to uploading the original recording.

review_after_return: The subsequent review will use these reports and lossless examples to decide pose recovery, depth registration, data conversion or a first custom-scene training run. No readiness conclusion is prefilled.
